scenes.heading: Human evolution
scenes.sub: One twig on a bushy family tree
scenes.say: Humans are one twig on a big, bushy family tree of species that walked upright. Fossils, tools and ancient DNA let us trace how our lineage changed, and explain features like your arched feet and large brain.

scenes.heading: Think of it like this
scenes.everyday: You share grandparents with your cousin, but you didn't come from them
scenes.science: Humans and chimpanzees share a common ancestor
scenes.breaks: cousins are two generations apart, but our split from chimps was hundreds of thousands of generations ago.
scenes.say: Chimpanzees are our cousins, not our grandparents. We share a common ancestor that lived roughly six to seven million years ago, and both lineages have changed since. Hominins are everyone on our side of the family after that split. And the tree is a bush, not a ladder.

scenes.heading: Built for walking upright
steps: Arched foot, big toe in line
scenes.say: Bipedalism defines hominins. Go top down: hole, spine, hips, thighs, feet. The foramen magnum sits centrally under the skull, like a ball balanced on a broomstick. Then an S-shaped spine, a bowl-shaped pelvis, femurs angled inwards, and an arched foot with the big toe in line.

scenes.heading: Bigger brains over time
scenes.say: Brains grew in steps. Australopithecus had about four to five hundred cubic centimetres, Homo habilis about six hundred, Homo erectus about nine hundred to eleven hundred, and Homo sapiens about thirteen hundred and fifty. Faces got flatter and teeth smaller. But feet came before brains: Lucy walked upright with an ape-sized brain.
scenes.caption: Brains grew in steps. Australopithecus had about 400–500 cm³, Homo habilis about 600, Homo erectus about 900–1100, and Homo sapiens about 1350. Faces got flatter and teeth smaller. But feet came before brains: Lucy walked upright with an ape-sized brain.

scenes.heading: Worked example
scenes.question: A skull is about 1000 cm³, with large brow ridges, no chin and a moderately flat face. Hand axes lie nearby. Which species?
lines: 1000 cm³: bigger than habilis, below sapiens
Brow ridges, no chin: not sapiens
Shaped hand axes: linked to erectus
scenes.say: A skull of about one thousand cubic centimetres is bigger than Homo habilis, but below Homo sapiens. Large brow ridges and no chin rule out sapiens. Hand axes are linked to Homo erectus. So it's Homo erectus.

scenes.heading: Out of Africa
points: Greatest mtDNA diversity is in Africa
Australia reached at least 50 000 years ago
scenes.say: Homo sapiens evolved in Africa, then some groups migrated out. Mitochondrial DNA is most diverse in Africa, because people have lived there longest. Ancient DNA shows some interbreeding with Neanderthals and Denisovans. People reached Australia at least fifty thousand years ago.

points: Hominins: walk upright on two legs
Common ancestor with chimps, 6–7 million years ago
Out of Africa, with some interbreeding
scenes.say: Quick recap. Hominins are defined by walking upright. We share a common ancestor with chimps. Feet came before big brains. The family tree is a bush, and our species came out of Africa. Now try the practice questions!
